CVE-2024-22373.title: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the JPEG2000Codec: ...
CVE-2024-22373.description: An out-of-bounds write vulnerability exists in the JPEG2000Codec::DecodeByStreamsCommon functionality of Mathieu Malaterre Grassroot DICOM 3.0.23. A specially crafted DICOM file can lead to a heap buffer overflow. An attacker can provide a malicious file to trigger this vulnerability.
